DA-22
Peer-well reference rate card
Unit rates are uniform campaign-wide; missing rates are imputable from peer wells

295 normalised unit/description keys (202 multi-well, 93 single-well): 122 uniform card (<5% spread), 3 low dispersion, 77 dispersed. Of 1176 priced lines, 1057 (89.9%) sit within 5% of the peer reference; 119 lines deviate >5%. 376 lines lack a unit price: 8 can be priced from the peer card, 368 remain open data gaps. Embedded margin vs own-line arithmetic (DA-01 basis): +166,949 / -8,926,122 (net -8,759,173 USD). Margin vs peer card on uniform-card keys only (834 lines): +165,938 / -1,603,805 (net -1,437,868 USD).

Unit rates of a defined operation/commodity are uniform campaign-wide (project confirmation 2026-11-08). Deviations beyond a few percent reflect scope, hole size or contract-bundle differences, or incomplete source data — never noise to auto-correct. Large positive line deltas (source Total above QTY x rate) are the embedded company margin (profit/overhead), not arithmetic errors; the negative side is dominated by lump-sum/zero-total contingency lines. The 77 dispersed keys are scope sign-offs and are excluded from the uniform-card margin figure.

Adopt an_unit_rate_reference as the campaign reference card for CBS audits and future AFEs; re-price the 8 imputable gap lines with the peer median (flagged in an_cbs_reference_delta), resolve the 368 unimputable gaps at source, and sign off every DISPERSED-key scope before invoice settlement; retain source values verbatim in parallel.
